nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) tracking token balances; mutated by _transfer and initialized in the constructor.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of ERC20 allowances; written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Private constant-in-practice total supply (1000*10**9*10**18) assigned to the deployer balance in the constructor.
Private owner address in Ownable; read by owner(), cleared by renounceOwnership and reassigned by transferOwnership.
Private address initialized with _msgSender() at declaration and used by the onlyOwner modifier as the access-control check instead of _owner.
StaxProtocol constructor; mints the entire _tTotal supply to _msgSender() and emits Transfer.
Public ERC20 approve override; forwards _msgSender() and spender/amount to _approve.
Public ERC20 transferFrom override; calls _transfer then decreases the spender allowance and calls _approve with the reduced amount.
Public ERC20 transfer override; calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Internal transfer routine; SafeMath-subtracts from the sender balance, adds to the recipient balance and emits Transfer.
Private approval routine; performs zero-address checks and, when the owner is not the protocol owner(), force-resets the allowance to 0 and emits Approval with a hardcoded amount of 4.
Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender]; note the parameter names shadow the owner() function.
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public view returning the fixed _tTotal supply.
Public view returning _owner; its return value is compared with the approver inside _approve to decide whether to wipe the allowance.
Owner-guarded function that emits OwnershipTransferred and sets _owner to address(0); guarded by onlyOwner which checks newComer.
Private owner-guarded function reassigning _owner to newOwner after a zero-address check; guarded by onlyOwner which checks newComer.
Attacker-controllable caller identity used via _msgSender() throughout the token (constructor, approve, transfer, transferFrom) and to seed the newComer access-control state variable.
In _approve: if the approver is not owner(), _allowances[ol][tt] is forcibly set to 0, silently discarding any existing allowance and allowing griefing of third-party approvals.
In _approve's reset branch an Approval event is emitted with the literal constant 4 rather than the real allowance, producing an event that misreports state to off-chain consumers.
Address library performs raw recipient.call{value:...}("") in sendValue/_functionCallWithValue without a reentrancy guard, forwarding value to an arbitrary address.
spender parameter of approve(); the address granted the allowance.
amount parameter of approve(); the allowance value requested by the caller.
sender parameter of transferFrom(); the account whose tokens are moved.
recipient parameter of transferFrom(); the account receiving the tokens.
amount parameter of transferFrom(); value subtracted from sender balance and from the spender allowance.
recipient parameter of transfer(); the destination account.
amount parameter of transfer(); value moved from _msgSender().
sender parameter of internal _transfer().
recipient parameter of internal _transfer().
amount parameter of internal _transfer(); SafeMath-subtracted from sender and added to recipient.
ol (owner) parameter of _approve(); compared against owner() and used as the _allowances key.
tt (spender) parameter of _approve(); used as the inner _allowances key.
amount parameter of _approve(); stored in _allowances only when ol == owner().
account parameter of balanceOf(); key used to read _balances.
owner parameter of allowance(); shadows the owner() function and keys _allowances.
spender parameter of allowance(); inner key of _allowances.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(); the address written into _owner.
Local bool capturing the success flag of the low-level value call in Address.sendValue/_functionCallWithValue.
Local bytes32 codehash obtained via extcodehash in Address.isContract and compared against the EOA hash constant.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read via _msgSender() in the constructor to seed the initial balance.
The _tTotal supply value flows into _balances[_msgSender()] during construction.
approve() passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner into _approve.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
newComer is initialized from _msgSender() at declaration, making the onlyOwner check depend on caller identity.
allowance() reads the nested _allowances mapping for the owner/spender pair.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] before subtracting the transferred amount.
_approve writes (or force-resets) _allowances[ol][tt].
_transfer reads and mutates _balances for both sender and recipient.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
totalSupply() returns the fixed _tTotal value.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_approve compares ol against owner() to decide between storing the amount and force-resetting the allowance to zero.
renounceOwnership overwrites _owner with the zero address.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with newOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership by requiring newComer == _msgSender().
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership by requiring newComer == _msgSender().
approve() delegates all logic to the private _approve helper.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom() re-invokes _approve with the decremented allowance value.
transfer() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
_approve executes the branch that forcibly sets _allowances[ol][tt] = 0 whenever the approver is not owner().
_approve emits Approval(ol, tt, 4) with a hardcoded constant in the reset branch.

normalization_plan.reason: spender is only consumed by approve() when forwarding to _approve.
amount is only consumed by approve() when forwarding to _approve.
sender keys the balance and allowance updates performed inside transferFrom.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom.
amount is subtracted from the spender allowance within transferFrom.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
amount is only forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
sender selects the balance slot debited by _transfer.
recipient selects the balance slot credited by _transfer.
amount is the SafeMath value moved between balances in _transfer.
ol drives the owner() comparison and the forced allowance reset inside _approve.
tt is the inner allowance key written by _approve.
amount is the value stored into _allowances by _approve.
account is the sole lookup key of the balanceOf view.
owner is the outer lookup key of the allowance view.
spender is the inner lookup key of the allowance view.
newOwner is assigned into the _owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
success only records the outcome of the raw value call in the Address library.
codehash only supports the contract-existence guard that precedes the low-level call in the Address library.
